text: ← RETURN TO SELECTED WORK HANS AARON LAURELES · CAVITE, PH THE ENGINEER BEHIND THE ARCHITECTURE I build AI agents that are useful, and interfaces people enjoy using. I'm Hans Aaron Laureles, a Computer Science graduate from De La Salle University–Dasmariñas focused on AI agent teams that use real tools, running models locally or in the cloud, and the full-stack web apps around them. I studied distributed computing, databases and algorithms. When language models started using real tools instead of only generating text, I moved my focus there: sharing work across several AI models, running them on my own computer, and making sure they use tools predictably. My frontend and UI/UX work, sharpened during my internship at ROC.PH, shapes how I build agents: I treat them as products people use. The agents are hosted on my own PC, and the screens around them should be quick to read and hard to misuse. // 01 · TRACK RECORD Engineering Experience & Systems 📄 Executive Cards 🌿 $ git log --graph UI/UX & Frontend Engineer Intern ROC.PH Digital Marketing Services · General Trias, Cavite, Philippines JUN 2024 – AUG 2024 Designed web pages in Figma that work on any screen size, following established usability guidelines and a shared design system. Turned those designs into accessible HTML, CSS, Tailwind and React for live client websites. Worked in agile sprints with daily standups, code reviews, Git, and quick rounds of client feedback. Creator & AI Systems Architect — Manas: Ciel Autonomous Voice Copilot & Real-Time Cognitive HUD · Solo Workstation Project 2026 – PRESENT Built a voice assistant you talk to out loud: it turns speech into text (Groq Whisper), answers in Japanese and English, and speaks with a custom voice filter. Ciel can check the weather, search the web, remember the recent conversation, and read and write my Obsidian notes. Built an animated web dashboard whose rings and waveform move with Ciel's voice. Developer & Creator — LSFM AI HQ Autonomous Multi-Agent Operations Platform · Solo Workstation Project 2025 – PRESENT Built LSFM AI HQ, a 5-agent team on Discord where each agent has one job: daily briefings, email triage, job applications, design reviews, and code checks. The agents use cloud AI (Groq and Gemini, each a backup for the other) or a local model on my own computer for private work, and I choose the mode. Built the tools they use: a resume builder that makes a one-page PDF for applicant tracking systems, and an email sorter that labels my inbox and archives clutter without deleting anything. Developer — Cognitive Memory Core Lessons-Learned Memory for AI Coding Assistants · Open-Source Project 2024 – 2025 Built a memory for AI coding assistants in plain Python, with no outside packages to install. Before each coding task, it searches past lessons by keyword and shows the ones that apply. Each mistake is saved as a lesson (what happened, why, and the rule for next time), so the assistant is less likely to repeat it. Lead Mobile Developer & Systems Builder — Capstone: Patriot DLSU–Dasmariñas · BS Computer Science Capstone 2023 – 2024 Designed and built a mobile app (React Native, TypeScript) that matches university students by shared interests. Connected it to an AWS backend (Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito sign-in) with Redis caching so profiles load quickly. Ran usability tests with students and used the results to improve navigation, forms and layout. // 02 · CONTINUOUS LEARNING Applied AI Competencies & Growth What I'm practising now: getting AI agents to work together, running AI models on my own computer, and making them use tools reliably. ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers DeepLearning.AI · Co-created with OpenAI PRACTICE Writing instructions that get reliable, structured answers from AI models, and breaking big tasks into smaller steps. Local Models on My GPU Ollama · on my own graphics card PRACTICE Running smaller open AI models on an ordinary gaming graphics card, so private work can stay on my computer. // 03 · CAPABILITIES Core Engineering & Design Stack Applied AI & Agents Multi-Agent Systems Hybrid Vector RAG (Dense + BM25) Model Context Protocol (MCP) LLM Evaluations Local GPU Inference (Ollama) Ollama & GGUF Quantization Structured JSON Schemas Tool & Function Calling Hybrid Cloud/Local Routing Groq & Gemini APIs Dense & Sparse Embeddings Persistent Agent Memory Systems & Cloud Automation Python (asyncio & OOP) Google Workspace REST APIs Headless Chromium / Edge Discord Gateway API AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB) Redis Caching & Queues Node.js & Express OAuth2 Credential Flow Git & CI/CD Pipelines Interface Craft & Design React TypeScript & ES6+ Design Tokens & CSS Vars Figma Prototyping Tailwind CSS WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance Information Architecture Micro-Interactions Usability Benchmarking Hiring for AI or full-stack work? Let’s talk. I'm based in Cavite, Philippines, and open to full-time remote Applied AI and full-stack roles. hanslaureles92@gmail.com [Copy] Download Resume (PDF) ↗ GitHub Profile ↗
